goal: Enforce bounds checking on numeric configuration options across node startup, mempool, and wallet
Reject out-of-range values with fatal errors instead of silently wrapping integers or inverting logic
agreement: Concept support for fixing invalid argument handling and bad negation options (l0rinc, ryanofsky, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: validation should be centralized in args handler rather than piecemeal (sedited)
Unaddressed objection: chrono cannot handle i64 tip age so it should parse as u32 (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: test loop binds reference to temporary strings causing CI failure (l0rinc)

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because it prevents negative values from bypassing datacarrier limits or inverting expiration logic
It affects startup argument checking rather than core mempool validation, data structures, or eviction

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because rejecting out-of-range options prevents silent integer wrapping and startup misconfigurations
Clear benefit for node operators debugging bad settings, though fixing these edge cases is deferrable
